data.narrative:
Chemify, a Series B biotech company founded by Leroy Cronin, has raised $93M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 4 private peers in Biotech & Health at Series B/C stages (Eikon Therapeutics, Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) plus 3 public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $177M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produces $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales (sector median 9.2x) cannot be applied due to absence of Chemify's revenue data. These two methods triangulate to a range of $150M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide dispersion reflects substantial uncertainty around stage-of-funding valuation relative to later-stage peers. Key uncertainties include Chemify's revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts, and market timing within a volatile biotech funding environment.
